strategy_roster.name: Bitcoin Momentum
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,20) and roc(close,7) > 0 and atr(high,low,close,5) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20) represents the higher-timeframe trend, while seven-bar ROC and ATR(5) approximate momentum and the documented trailing-volatility context. Weekly EMA, the trailing-stop calculation, caution condition, and time dates are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: iMA iStochastic Custom
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20) with a 1% envelope is an explicit fallback for the missing MA period and pip offsets; RSI(14)>50 is the stochastic confirmation proxy. Stochastic K/D, exact envelope shifts, money modes, and pip protections are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: SilverTrend V3 JTPO
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(12/26) alignment and normalized volume provide a deterministic proxy for the unavailable SilverTrend and JTPO indicators. Point-based initial/trailing stops, the Friday cutoff, and custom statistical filter are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: BykovTrend + ColorX2MA
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) and an EMA/SMA slope cross are explicit proxies for the Williams %R and two-stage ColorX2MA blocks. The two independent timeframe blocks, applied-price modes, signal delays, and all permission toggles are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Autonomous 5-Minute Robot
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > sma(close,50) and roc(close,6) > 0 and volume_ratio(volume,10) > 1
strategy_roster.notes: The documented SMA(50), six-bar comparison, and VolumeLength(10) are retained; volume_ratio(10)>1 proxies buy volume exceeding sell volume. The source's 3% stop and 29% target are encoded exactly; the 5-minute clock is not.

strategy_roster.name: Early Bird Range Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 20-bar high break and RSI(14)>50 proxy the pre-market range breakout bias. Session/range hours, entry buffer, pip targets/stops, daily close, and volatility trailing controls are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Daily Breakpoint
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 10-bar high break with positive momentum is a price-based proxy for the daily-open breakout. Stored daily open, previous-bar size/body gates, point-based stop/target, and trailing settings are not available.

strategy_roster.name: Three Candles Reversal
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and roc(close,1) > 0 and roc(close,3) > 0 and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1
strategy_roster.notes: Bullish multi-bar momentum with normalized volume confirmation approximates the three-candle reversal; the exact rolling candle-pattern buffer cannot be represented. Optional volume modes, signal-bar offset, and pip stops/targets are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: FitFul 13 Time Gated
strategy_roster.notes: The weekly pivot ladder is approximated by prior 20-bar range boundaries and their crosses. Pivot formulas, allowed-minute gate, confirmation timeframe, offset targets, and trailing/Friday controls are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Multi-Timeframe RSI Grid Strategy with Arrows
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14)<30 and a valid ATR(14) series provide a long-side oversold/grid proxy; RSI>70 is the reversion exit. Higher-timeframe RSI alignment, ATR grid spacing, lot multipliers, daily profit target, and drawdown management are omitted.
